checks: source playback and audio-routing callbacks preserve geometry, validate atomically and support Undo/Redo
hidden Sources window Play/Pause/Seek/Follow actions isolate the source clock and reject obsolete document callbacks
original PNG folder import freezes numeric order, retains geometry/history and admits new frames only by explicit refresh
effective opacity automation admits and decodes original managed MOV frames even when the saved base opacity is zero
schema-13 Save/Open and portable collection retain source settings, audio matrix, UUIDs and folder manifests
available recovery uses the decision callback, selects the restored model and is removed by its next successful Save
a sidecar corrupted during the Restore decision retains the clean saved model, reconciles adapters and preserves the diagnostic bytes
stale and corrupt recovery open without a modal decision and remain preserved even after an explicit Save
explicit Discard removes owned bound recovery and preserves unrelated invalid sidecars
limitations: Automatic hidden native callbacks, not manual GUI evidence. No user project, camera, external display, physical audio/MIDI/light device, audible-output or long-show claim. The dedicated process durability mode checks forced termination separately.
scope: Production source/editor commands, hidden Sources window callbacks, original PNG/MOV fixtures, schema-13 persistence and bound recovery; focused independent harness
